source_metadata.title: The Efficacy and Safety of Tranexamic Acid in Revision Total Knee and Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

source_internal_inconsistencies.issue: The abstract prints the rTHA RBC-unit WMD as +0.98, whereas the Results text and Figure 5a show -0.98.
source_internal_inconsistencies.resolution: The atom uses -0.98 because the main Results text and forest plot agree on the negative sign.

source_internal_inconsistencies.issue: The prose describing double-dose IV TXA and calculated blood loss omits negative signs in the WMD and confidence interval.
source_internal_inconsistencies.resolution: The atom uses Figure S12 values: WMD -407.63 mL, 95% CI -645.01 to -170.26.

schema_gaps: The governing LiteratureAtom model is oriented toward primary literature; this source is a systematic review/meta-analysis. Review-level pooled estimates are represented as the review's own quantitative results, while individual-study findings are explicitly tagged secondary_reported_result.
There is no dedicated systematic-review recommendation atom kind; the paper's proposed clinical recommendations are represented as author_conclusion atoms with proposed_clinical_recommendation tags.
The QuantitativeResult model has no structured heterogeneity field, so I² values are preserved in canonical statements rather than a dedicated field.
The model has no structured field for source-rated evidence strength; Table 2 strength labels are preserved in canonical statements and tags.
extraction_limitations: Dense study-level baseline characteristics and every regimen cell in Table 1 were not expanded into one atom per table cell; extraction prioritizes review-level methods, pooled estimates, clinically material non-pooled comparisons, safety findings, recommendations, and limitations.
Bibliographic reference entries were treated as provenance infrastructure rather than evidence atoms.
No underlying primary study was treated as if it had been directly read; study-level findings taken from this review are tagged secondary_reported_result.

key_figures_or_tables_inspected: Figures S1-S19 (pages 14-23, with key pooled estimates checked against forest plots)
